from pydantic import BaseModel

    created_at_from: Optional[datetime] = None   # inclusive start

    id: int
    customer_id: int
    status: str
    created_at: datetime

class SearchResponse(BaseModel):
    items: list[OrderItem]
    page: int
    page_size: int
    total: int
